context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 8 verified WebSocket real-time sync features. Backend has SyncWebSocketManager class (lines 61-97 in server.py) that manages WebSocket connections and broadcasts. POST /api/agent/sync-progress receives progress events from desktop agent and broadcasts to all connected WebSocket clients. Frontend useSyncWebSocket hook connects to wss://...//api/ws/sync-status and updates syncProgress state. SyncStatusBar component renders progress/complete/error states based on syncProgress. SyncConnectionBadge shows 'Live' when WebSocket is connected.

backend_endpoints.POST /api/agent/sync-progress: Receives progress events and broadcasts to WebSocket clients
backend_endpoints.WebSocket /api/ws/sync-status: Accepts connections, sends last_progress on connect, handles get_status action
backend_endpoints.POST /api/agent/sync: Existing endpoint still works for inventory/sales/customers data
backend_endpoints.GET /api/sync/status: Returns last sync info from database

SyncStatusBar.error_state: Shows red alert icon, error message
